text:
maya: quick check — planning to start canary for model v6 tomorrow. plan: 2% EU -> 5% APAC -> 10% NA over 48h. any objections?

sam: sounds good. are we gating on latency or quality?

maya: primary gates = p95 latency (<220ms) and hallucination rate on our eval set (<1.2%). also error rate <0.2%.

leo: can you paste the flag config you plan to flip? want to make sure rollout scopes the customer tiers correctly.

maya: sure, snippet below (will apply via toggle-service):

```json
{
  "flag": "model_v6_canary",
  "scopes": ["region:eu,apac,na"],
  "percentages": {"eu": 2, "apac": 5, "na": 10},
  "audience": "all-paid,internal-beta",
  "safety_fallback": "model_v5",
  "auto_rollback": {"p95_latency_ms": 300, "error_rate": 0.5}
}
```

tanvi: small nit — audience should exclude trial accounts (we don't want noisy small apps skewing eval). add `!tier:trial`.

maya: good catch. updated. also will enable prefix caching for v6 to reduce p95 risk.

sam: who will own metric watch? canary-alerts maybe? if we need manual pause, who has the toggle perms?

leo: i'll be on monitoring for the first 4h. @maya can you add me as emergency approver in the toggle UI?

maya: done. added leo and sam to approvers.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled by maya for 2024-05-14T08:00Z. Initial rollout: eu=2% apac=5% na=10%. Alerts: canary_p95, canary_hallucination_rate, canary_error_rate.

sam: quick ask — do we want a slow-start in apac given smaller traffic? maybe start apac at 1% and jump to 5% after 6h if signals are green.

maya: OK changing apac plan: 1% -> 5% after 6h. will update toggle.

leo: add a note to the release doc about the fallback model and the prompt-set used for halluc checks. saves time if we need to run postmortem.

maya: will update. also tagging #oncall in case of noisy errors at ramp.

tanvi: LGTM. one more thing — canary schedule should include off-hours safety window for NA so we don't blast customers late at night. do we have that?

maya: yes NA ramp only during 14:00-22:00 UTC window. added to rollout plan.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 2024-05-14T08:00Z. Current distribution: eu=2% apac=1% na=0%. Tracking metrics: p95=, error_rate=, halluc_rate=.

sam: thanks — i'll keep an eye on p95 and errors for the first 2h. ping here if anything off. :eyes:

leo: will do metric diffs every 30m for first 3h.

maya: thanks team. i'll post updates with the toggle events and any rollback actions.

deploy-bot: Canary update @ 2024-05-14T08:30Z: p95=210ms, error_rate=0.05%, halluc_rate=0.9% — all green so far.

maya: perfect, proceeding with apac bump to 5% in 5m.

sam: ack.

leo: ack.

maya: apac bumped to 5%. NA scheduled to start ramp at 14:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary update @ 2024-05-14T09:10Z: apac p95=230ms (slightly above target), investigating.

sam: noted — can we temporarily reduce apac to 2% until we know root cause?

maya: lowering apac to 2% now.

deploy-bot: Flag updated: apac=2%.

leo: thanks. will correlate with infra spikes and kernel variance.

maya: follow-up action items: 1) add trial-exclusion to audience (done), 2) update release doc (i'll do), 3) add post-rollout eval run for halluc set (tanvi?), 4) ensure rollback playbook pinned in channel.

tanvi: i'll take the post-rollout eval.

maya: great — closing loop here, will post final summary after NA ramp finishes. :white_check_mark:
